text:
Type: long TV console with open shelves
Use: holding a TV, media devices and remotes; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, minimalist, mid-century modern
Materials: smooth lacquered board, slim metal legs
Colors: warm off-white, cream
Shape: long low cabinet on four thin straight legs, three open compartments along the top, two wide fronts below with a gently curved lower edge, slim top, light and floating
Feel: soft, airy, clean, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, beige or grey sofas, brass or white accents; contemporary or Scandinavian living rooms
